name: Kelp on the shallow rock
plain: Kelp grows on rock below the low-tide line, down as deep as the light reaches; it is the green-brown patches you see through the water.
confidence: medium: curves from World's levels/downeast/coast_rules.json (21 Oct), checked against the Bar Harbor shore and cited above; Matt's field corrections still to come

sources.cite: Steneck, R.S. et al. (2002) Kelp forest ecosystems: biodiversity, stability, resilience and future. Environ. Conserv. 29: 436-459.
sources.note: Saccharina and Laminaria on Gulf of Maine subtidal rock to ~10-15 m, densest where waves keep urchins and silt off
